subject.title: ci: stress race detection with a GOMAXPROCS sweep and repeat count

question: Should this repository accept 20 race-test executions per full Ubuntu/macOS CI workflow to increase coverage of scheduling-dependent races?
rationale: The patch is correct and proven, but the appropriate recurring reliability-versus-runner-budget tradeoff is repository policy rather than a mechanical code decision.

options.title: Accept the bounded race sweep
options.body: Merge the two-value GOMAXPROCS matrix with `-count=5`, accepting the higher recurring CI cost for stronger race detection.

options.title: Reduce the recurring stress cost
options.body: Ask for a smaller repeat count or a scheduled-only stress workflow if the full pull-request cadence exceeds the desired runner budget.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded race sweep
recommendation.body: Merge the two-value GOMAXPROCS matrix with `-count=5`, accepting the higher recurring CI cost for stronger race detection.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved question is the repository's CI reliability and runner-budget policy.
